headline: Badland Banditos: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Badland Banditos is projected #9 of 16 with a 614.80 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Ja'Marr Chase, Brock Bowers, and Kenneth Walker. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core.

latest_trade.summary: On June 24, Badland Banditos traded with Crimson Tide Pods and acquired Kenneth Walker, 2027 Round 3 (Crimson Tide Pods) while sending Chris Rodriguez, 2026 Round 1 (Corgi Loaf Baking Co.), 2026 Round 1 (All Hail King Jesus). Kenneth Walker is now the current RB starter at 87.2 C-AVI and 86.2 D-AVI; The deal sent out 2 draft assets, reducing future flexibility; The deal added 1 draft asset.
